historyComment: Built a TypeScript/Node.js AI Marketplace service with in-memory agent registration, governed catalog search, runtime resolution, heartbeat updates, and a marketplace overview endpoint. Added unit and HTTP integration tests, plus repository documentation in README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/architecture.md, and docs/decisions.md. Verified with npm run check, npm test, and npm run build.
